steps.action_code:
vacation_spot_plan = []
seen_vacation_spots = set()
for returned_path in photos_subdirectories:
    vacation_spot = returned_path.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
    if vacation_spot and vacation_spot != "vacations" and vacation_spot not in seen_vacation_spots:
        seen_vacation_spots.add(vacation_spot)
        vacation_spot_plan.append({"vacation_spot": vacation_spot, "directory_path": "~/photos/" + vacation_spot, "compressed_file_path": "~/photos/vacations/" + vacation_spot + ".tar"})
vacation_spot_plan.sort(key=lambda item: item["vacation_spot"])
print(vacation_spot_plan)
